items.title: The Gorenstein locus of a flat finitely presented map of spaces is open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces locally of finite presentation over S which is flat, the set of points where f is Gorenstein is open in |X|; the author reduces to the corresponding schemes-side openness through an etale chart of Y and a scheme presentation of X over it. The retained proof is written: take a scheme V etale surjective over Y, base change to X_V, the property of being Gorenstein is smooth-local on source and target so |X_V| -> |X| is an open map reflecting the locus, the schemes-side result (cited More on Morphisms lemma: flat lfp morphism, Gorenstein locus open) gives the openness in X_V, and openness descends along the surjective open map of spaces. The proof's commutative square appears without an inline gloss of its universal property, but every logical step names its input lemma; the omission is typographical, not a hidden argument. Retained author proof at lines 6720-6737.
